scope.extraction_location: temporary directory; not committed or published
scope.visual_method: Human review of contact sheets containing every source image, with filenames. Each thumbnail was approximately 210 by 150 pixels. Selected images showing people or third-party marks were then reviewed at full resolution.

findings.people_observation: Several photographs show partial bodies, arms, or hands of diners or workers. No clearly recognizable face was observed in the contact sheets or selected full-resolution examples; this is not a formal identity clearance.
findings.third_party_mark_observation: Brand names, logos, and product packaging are visible on plates, cups, bottles, and food containers in multiple images. A QR-code-like printed mark is visible in Buffet Food waste/IMG_5484.JPG.
dataset_quality_observations: Images include event/table context, packaging, plates, discarded food, and outdoor waste scenes. Folder labels can correlate with venue, background, containers, or camera framing rather than a consistent visual definition of food waste.

Wedding Food waste has 320 images while Vegetables waste has 16. Sequential and timestamped filenames suggest neighboring captures may share a scene or event; the existing random split does not establish capture-group independence.
Images depict food leftovers or discarded vegetables but do not measure mass, cost, or prevalence of food waste.

folder_label_content_review.overall_assessment: Images in each folder generally match the folder topic; they depict food leftovers or discarded food/vegetable material in the named collection context.

categories.Buffet Food waste: Leftovers on buffet plates and serving dishes.
categories.Food waste (General): Mixed food leftovers, discarded food, and containers.
categories.Restaurant food waste: Food remains on plates and trays in restaurant settings.
categories.Wedding Food waste: Leftovers and serving scenes from banquet or wedding settings.

educational_use.recommended_activity: Classify images by the folder category and inspect examples where the setting or food makes the category clear.
educational_use.limitation: The labels describe the collection context; the images do not measure the amount or prevalence of food waste.

publication_decision.reason: The folder contents are broadly consistent with their labels. Partial people and third-party product/plate marks are visible in some images. Keep the existing image files intact; document attribution and confirm the dataset redistribution scope before creating a public release asset.
